pages.text: $(l)Skill Caps$()$(li)Skills cap at 100; leveling beyond 100 provides no benefit except for one skill granting extra HP, which is not worth the effort.$(li)Do not attempt skill cycling (resetting to level 1 for XP boost)—it is not useful.

$(l)Skill Crystals$()$(li)Once you reach level 15, use Skill Crystals to quickly level to 100.$(li)Four full stacks of Skill Crystals will take you from level 15 to 100.$(li)Crystals are easily obtained from mob farms (e.g., Cursed Earth), Woot mob duplicators, or rare drops.
